catSync.intro: Turn the same Discord ↔ Echo message options on or off for every text and forum channel in this category. Each channel still uses its own linked Discord channel from import (you can fine-tune one channel in channel settings).
catSync.noteBefore: Turning both off and saving only stops linking when no custom posting link is saved. Use
catSync.noteAfter: to fully remove links. Channels you cannot manage are skipped.
